flavor: Resting atop a pedestal of calcified bone is a miniature, ornate catapult. Instead of stones, its basket is filled with tightly wrapped, glowing heads of 卷心菜. A faint, rhythmic thumping sound emanates from the mechanism, like a slow, undead heartbeat.
name: The Verdant Siege Engine
reason: The party discovers a strange, organic siege engine that seems to possess a rudimentary, zombie-like vitality.
